name: GM - Toledo Propulsion Systems, Toledo OH

fieldNotes.facility: Positively identified as GM Toledo Propulsion Systems (formerly Toledo Transmission), 1455 W Alexis Rd. The roster's approximate coords landed in a residential block east of the plant; re-pinned to the large industrial complex on the west side of the N-S rail corridor along W Alexis Rd. Web sources confirm a ~2.8M sq ft, ~151-acre GM transmission factory at this address (Wikipedia 'Toledo Transmission'; GM facilities page).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Site is fully fenced (perimeter chain-link visible in every Street View frame along W Alexis Rd). Main truck/freight circulation enters via a fenced driveway on the SW/west side of the property; gated, lane-controlled access. Employee/visitor frontage with a GM monument sign and office building is a separate point on the south (W Alexis) face.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Controlled fenced auto-plant entry; a small structure consistent with a gatehouse sits at the west truck driveway. Booth not crisply resolved in available imagery, so flagged uncertain, but guarded access is standard for a GM assembly/powertrain plant of this scale.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimate from overhead imagery: long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in along the north and west faces of the main building (50+ band). Distributed across multiple building faces.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large organized drop/trailer-storage yard north of the main building with dozens of parked trailers in marked rows (50+); separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Trailers backed into docks on distinct north and west building faces indicate physically separate shipping/receiving dock clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple active rail spurs run N-S directly through the property between the plant and the eastern storage lot; rail boxcars visible parked on the spurs in tight imagery.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck aprons and deep internal circulation drives provide room to add a bypass/express lane at the gate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approximate; west truck driveway reads as roughly 2 inbound lanes, 1 outbound — low confidence from overhead.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; left uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Toledo metro fabric, surrounded by residential street grid and other industry on all sides; classified Urban.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Single integrated plant complex (one large connected building plus minor outbuildings); the eastern lot across the rail is a vehicle/trailer marshalling/storage area of the same site, not a second plant cluster.

citations.claim: GM Toledo Propulsion Systems is GM-operated; new GM investment to add an 8-speed FWD transmission variant and expand 10-speed capacity; ~1,650 employees
GM investing ~$40M into Toledo Propulsion Systems transmission plant

verification.rationale: GM-owned, self-operated transmission plant (1455 W Alexis Rd) with active 2026 GM investment and >$1B invested since 2011; retained by New GM, not part of the 2009 MLC/RACER divestiture.
